root_cause: PR #2097 intentionally ended at a generic trusted-factory transport boundary. The repository has all lower components but no single closed configuration, loader, durable checkpointer construction, or atomic initializer that binds them for one project.
causal_chain: The Host CLI validates commands and loads an operator-selected module callable.
The Provider bootstrap constructs adapters but requires callers to supply all runtime configuration.
Starter installation and runtime registration are separate authoring commands.
No repository-owned component seals these outputs into one project-relative bootstrap.
Every Host/project integration must therefore duplicate security-sensitive assembly code.
rejected_hypotheses: Let untrusted Host commands select factories, paths, Providers, credentials, or permissions.
Generate an allow-all WriteAuthorityGuard for convenience.
Store GitHub tokens in generated configuration.
Create a second runtime, TaskRun writer, completion controller, or merge adapter.
Modify the independently runnable customer application.
